Are these tools really free?

The tools shown here are free, without account requirements or payment screens. Each PDF task supports up to 20 files, 30 MiB combined and 150 pages. PDF-to-JPG supports up to 40 selected pages. These limits protect browser memory.

Can I convert Word files or use OCR?

Not in this release. Office conversion, OCR, digital signing, encryption and advanced compression need additional processing engines and validation. We only list tools that have an implementation.

Can you always make a PDF smaller?

No. Optimize PDF rewrites PDF structure with object streams; it does not downsample scanned pages. Already optimized PDFs may not shrink. In that case we tell you and keep the original.

Will my documents leave my device?

Application processing stays in the browser. The host still receives ordinary website requests. There are no document uploads, ad scripts or analytics in this release. Read our privacy page for details.
